_README: FIXTURE, not a real dump — TODO_REPO_HYGIENE item 182. This is NOT what
scripts/dump-native-vocabulary.js produces; it is hand-built from
docs/analysis/cosmere-rpg-3.1.0-compatibility.md (blockers B1/B4/B5, break F1/F6,
and Appendix D) so lint-refs.js pass 11's per-type check has something 3.1.0-shaped to run
against before Ben's install is upgraded. The tracked data/native-vocabulary.json stays at
2.1.0 on purpose (item 182's brief) — do not copy this file over it, and do not treat its
per-type field lists as verified. They are exercised only by tests/dead-field-by-type.test.js.
The real per-type shapes must come from scripts/dump-native-vocabulary.js run against Ben's
actual 3.1.0 install at the flip (item 187), which is the only source of truth this repo
trusts for data/native-vocabulary.json itself.
systemSchemaTopLevelFields (the union): the tracked 2.1.0 file's 87 fields plus the 16
Appendix D lists as added at 3.1.0 (advantageMode, allowDuplicates, alwaysEquippable,
consumption, cost, equippableEnabled, fastForward, flavor, matchDocument, notify, plotDie,
skillTest, strike, temporaryDamageModifiers, temporaryModifiers, uuids) = 103, 0 removed —
this is the specific fact break F8 is about: the union alone cannot see a talent losing
activation/damage, because action/weapon still declare them.
systemSchemaFieldsByType (new in item 182): six item types named in the item text. Sourced
per-type as follows, each a reasoned approximation, not a measurement:
talent   — B1: ActivatableItemMixin + DamagingItemMixin REMOVED (no activation/damage/
strike); ResourcesItemMixin + LinkedSkillsMixin ADDED (resources, linkedSkills).
action   — B1/B4: activation + damage live ONLY here now; B4's new activation shape adds
consumption/cost/flavor; skillTest is new (B4); F6: modality is read off the action.
weapon   — B5: activation + damage REPLACED by strike {die, damageType, skill, skillLocked,
skillTestBonus, damageBonus} via StrikingItemMixin; generic physical-item fields
otherwise.
armor    — not detailed in the compatibility doc's blockers; generic physical-item fields,
deliberately WITHOUT activation/damage/strike (nothing in the doc gives armor any).
trait    — minimal: traits are passive descriptors with no activation of their own.
equipment— generic physical-item fields; alwaysEquippable (Appendix D's new union field)
plausibly belongs here by name.
Every field in every per-type list also appears in systemSchemaTopLevelFields — pinned by
tests/dead-field-by-type.test.js's fixture-consistency check.
